cleansingStrength.rationale: Low by C6: no strong anionic; earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate @2 with prominent amphoteric/glucoside co-surfactants (Cocamidopropyl Betaine @8, Coco-Betaine @16, Decyl Glucoside @17). Counter-signal: four mild anionics (@2-@5) precede the first amphoteric, which comes after the pearlizer; realistic unknowns could make the net cleansing moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High by C2: prominent silicone (Amodimethicone @9) plus cationic polymers (Polyquaternium-10 @25, Polyquaternium-7 @26; prominent because Parfum is last) plus pearlizing route (Glycol Distearate @7) plus closed-list humectants (Glycerin @6, Panthenol @21); also Cetrimonium Chloride @14 and a second silicone @18. Counter-signal: everything from @9 on is in an alphabetical (unordered, sub-1 %-type) zone, so doses are unknown and care could be bounded.

payload_lipid: non-material: Prunus Armeniaca Kernel Oil @30 (after W-line @10)

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate - two silicones (amodimethicone, divinyldimethicone copolymer), two cationic polymers and a quat converge, but all sit in the alphabetical low-dose zone
weightPotential.persistence: high - amodimethicone, divinyldimethicone/dimethicone crosspolymer, Polyquaternium-7 and -10 are substantive and plausibly persistent through dilution deposition
weightPotential.counterevidence: No material payload lipid (W-RICH does not hold; apricot oil @30 is after the W-line); all deposition routes are in the alphabetical tail zone; ordinary rinse-off.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: High via the convergence route: silicone + cationic polymer + cationic conditioner are three distinct plausibly persistent families (read without position test, W-LINE item 4), and weak reset does not offset them.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: three converging persistent non-lipid families against weak reset satisfy the high anchor's convergence route; the late (alphabetical-zone) position is the realistic unknown that sets confidence at moderate. The post-line apricot oil is not what keeps or makes the band.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: All deposition in an alphabetical zone of unknown dose; realistic unknowns could move it to moderate.
